sections.heading: About Halo Notes
sections.lead: Halo Notes is a secure, offline-first note app designed for field researchers. Our mission is to help you capture and organize your research notes efficiently.

items.title: Secure Data Storage
items.text: Our end-to-end encryption ensures that all your data is protected from unauthorized access.

items.title: Offline First Experience
items.text: Halo Notes allows you to work offline, ensuring that you can capture and organize your research notes even when there's no internet connection.

items.title: User-Friendly Interface
items.text: Our intuitive interface makes it easy for you to create, edit, and share your notes with others.

faq.a: Halo Notes is a secure, offline-first note app designed for field researchers.
Our offline-first approach ensures that all your data is protected from unauthorized access and allows you to capture and organize your notes even when there's no internet connection.

faq.q: What are the benefits of using Halo Notes?
faq.a: Halo Notes helps field researchers streamline their research notes, capture and organize them efficiently, and collaborate with colleagues and share them with others.
Our end-to-end encryption ensures that all your data is protected from unauthorized access.
